        The Samsung Galaxy S24 is an excellent smartphone overall. It offers a premium design, a stunning display, powerful performance, and great camera quality. Everything runs smoothly, and the user experience is top-notch.

        However, there are a few drawbacks. The battery life is not very impressive, and the phone tends to heat up during heavy use or while charging. Also, whether I charge it with a 25W or 15W charger, the charging speed feels almost the same, which is disappointing.

        Still, apart from these minor issues, it's a solid phone and performs really well in daily use.

        Defective Samsung S24 with Loose Power Button & Pre Activated Warranty
        Reviewed in India on 8 March 2026
        Colour: GraySize: 8GB RAM + 256GB StorageStyle Name: Galaxy S24 Marble Gray 8/256
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I received the Samsung Galaxy S24; however, the power button on the device is loose and pressed inward. The phone initially did not power on and required multiple attempts to start. I also own another S24 and the button on this unit clearly feels defective.

        I visited the Samsung Service Centre, as per them, the device shows a purchase / activation date of 31 January, and they cannot process a replacement since replacements are only allowed within 14 days of activation. This is concerning because I purchased the phone as a brand new device and expected the 12 month warranty to start from the date of delivery/receipt. However, it appears the device may have been pre-activated before being sold, which is not acceptable for a new product. I request Amazon to kindly review this issue and arrange a replacement ASAP.
